blocks.text: (Editor’s Note: The article below is an updated version of an earlier story published by INQUIRER Entertainment in October 2025 for Breast Cancer Awareness Months. ) Millions of women around the world have been facing the life-altering threat of breast cancer, and it often paints a grim picture given the alarming statistics each year. In our country, the Philippine Institute Development studies found that 32 Filipino women die of breast cancer daily—an unfortunate circumstance attributed to the low screening rate in the country.
